verdict.rationale: Published rules on what an authorized representative may do are a fair question for a government migration authority like BAMF, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack covers only general migration, integration, asylum, return and statistics topics. Nothing in it mentions authorization or power-of-attorney forms, representative roles, or acts that must be signed personally.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, exactly what a third party may and may not do on my behalf is published — the authorization forms, the roles, and which signatures stay personal
